acceptance_policy: Repair target errors without changing gold to fit outputs
Check preservation of known successful regression behavior
Separate audit usefulness from extraction correctness
Preserve errors, incomplete runs and all repeated outputs
Do not claim dataset-wide precision/recall from an eight-case regression
changes: Source-backed normalization of duplicate named assignments before orphan-group validation
State context and cancellation/history instructions for second-pass audit
No model, context-window, resolver/schema changes; no N01-N12 tuning or API evaluation
measurement_limits: One fresh run per candidate version, temperature 0.6; prompt change and provider sampling effects cannot be isolated.
All eight cases are development regression; same-assistant review, no independent benchmark.
Case success counts are not dataset-wide precision/recall.
No post-hoc gold or acceptance changes, no rerun replacing failed cases.
